routes.name: Uniform even-degree injection via Laurent freeness and exponent truncation

C9000316.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 316 (Curtis’s conjecture.; papers: The Stable Hurewicz Image of the Sphere at Two; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C316_CURTIS.statement: Manuscript thm:curtis asserts the positive stable mod-two Hurewicz image is spanned by the Hopf and existing Kervaire invariant-one images. This assertion is not verified by the local Tor audit.

C316_WEIGHTS.statement: Manuscript lem:weight-modules and lem:zero-weights identify suspended Dickson ideals and the preceding-level functional restriction; not audited here.

C316_CONES.statement: Manuscript lem:cone-square, prop:cone-extension and cor:tensor-detection supply nonzero tensors from actual sphere maps; not audited here.

C316_MILNOR.statement: The Dickson-coordinate primitive actions and square-coefficient expression for later primitives follow from the polynomial binomial/Cartan model and root polynomial.

C316_COINVAR.statement: Above the exponent floor, the E-coinvariant monomials have d0 exponent congruent to k and all other Dickson exponents odd.

C316_CARTIER.statement: Manuscript lem:cartier identifies the above-floor coinvariant submodule with the stated halved Dickson ideal; not audited here.

C316_FUNCTIONAL.statement: Manuscript lem:algebra-functional-halving derives n congruent to k modulo 2^v2(m) and c at least n+2^v2(m)-2 from the lifted functional; not audited here.

C316_LOCAL_FREE.statement: The Laurent Dickson algebra is free over the first-k exterior algebra, with the explicit orbit basis q_T(d0^-k product(dj,j>0)) over the Laurent square subring.

C316_TRUNCATION.statement: For finite Laurent coefficient vectors and a differential shifting each exponent by exactly one, ambient exactness fills every cycle above floor n inside coefficients at or above n, by truncating a filling.

C316_FLOOR_TOR.statement: For every positive homological degree s and every n>=0, Tor_s over the first-k primitives of Sigma^n d0^n Dk is canonically represented at the exponent floor and has internal degree congruent to s modulo two.

C316_TOR.statement: For k>=1, n>=0, n congruent to k mod 2, the manuscript projection I tensor_A Sigma^n d0^n Dk to the quotient by all Milnor primitives is injective on even-total-degree cycles.

C316_EVEN_VANISH.statement: Manuscript lem:algebra-even-vanishing uses Tor injection and the exponent bounds to kill non-power-of-two even Sq^m tensors; its other steps are not audited here.

C316_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Manuscript lem:algebra-obstruction excludes nonbottom weights except n=k=1 and power-of-two degrees when both the nonzero tensor and lifted functional hypotheses hold; not certified here.

C316_SQUARES.statement: Manuscript lem:algebra-odd-tensor and lem:algebra-near-top-square supply the odd-case tensor vanishing and the near-top square identities used in the even-case endpoint; not audited here.

C316_TERMINAL.statement: Manuscript last-root, fourth-power exclusion and terminal Hopf/Kervaire identification complete the geometric argument using additional literature; not audited here.

F316_MONOMIAL_SINGLE_PRIMITIVE_QUOTIENT_.statement: In OpenAI Family 316 (Curtis conjecture, algebra.tex lem:tor-injection), testing monomials or one Milnor primitive q_i at a time determines the quotient by all degree-two Steenrod relations and detects multi-component cycle cancellations.

F316_INFINITE_PRIMITIVE_STRICT_SHIFT.statement: In OpenAI Family 316 (Curtis conjecture), Milnor primitives q_i beyond the first k primitives preserve the strict exponent shift by one required to apply floor truncation directly to the full infinite primitive complex.
